import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
def nm(f,p0,n=8):
    best=None
    for s in range(n):
        p=np.random.RandomState(s).randn(len(p0))*0.8+p0
        try:
            r=least_squares(lambda q: f(q)-dP_dt, p)
            if best is None or r.cost<best.cost: best=r
        except Exception: pass
    return round(np.mean((best.fun)**2)/np.var(dP_dt),7), np.round(best.x,3)
